name: ze_Au6_MFI
title: Au6 @ MFI (channel intersection)
description: Au6 cluster at the intersection of the straight and sinusoidal 10-ring channels of a frozen all-silica MFI framework (silicalite-1; NEP89-relaxed orthorhombic cell, 288 framework atoms). Metal clusters encapsulated in MFI resist sintering (Goel, Zones and Iglesia, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 136, 15280 (2014)); for Au clusters in zeolites see Otto, Zones and Iglesia, J. Catal. 339, 195 (2016). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative (NEP89 GM: buckled Au6 anchored to the intersection wall); Au replaces Pd because NEP89 bonds Pd and Pt atoms to SiO4 edges of MFI (M-Si 2.4-2.5 A).
